reviews.t: Not your average wipe - thank goodness!
reviews.x: I just bought the L. pads for my daughter and figured I would add these to the cart.  We don't typically "do" wipes in our house - not even for makeup, because I don't want the harmful chemicals hurting any of us.  These are a healthier option though (thank you L.) and sometimes it's just really nice to be able to freshen up without a full blown shower.  The packaging is nice and they have a fresh clean scent to them that is pleasing.  Happy I found them.
I am pretty sure these gave me a yeast infection. The only time I have ever gotten them was when I took antibiotics, but the only thing I have done differently is use these wipes.

reviews.t: Great product! Great quality and scent
reviews.x: Amazing product. Smell is great and the quality is amazing. Definitely going to buy again! (Bought on my husbands account haha!)

I love these wipes and all L. products! I never used wipes before but these leave me feeling clean and refreshed...much better than just using toilet paper. What makes it even better is knowing that it is completely organic. I plan to use them while traveling and camping which I am really excited for.

I love that product, it smells good, it's natural, great for refreshing. But it is a pain to take the wipes out!! They come all at once so then I put them back inside the bag in a ball and just use that Technic since they stuck together. I have another pack of wipes that comes out perfectly from another brand so it's possible to make it work. It drives me nuts so I won't buy that otherwise good product anymore.

These wipes are fresh and durable, but smaller than some other brands. I find it frustrating that you have to reach into the pouch every single time you need to pull out another wipe; they don't connect or come out sequentially as they should. These are also quite expensive, so I will probably not buy again.

reviews.t: Refreshing and Healing Lady Wipes - Best New Product I've Bought
reviews.x: These are the best. I am astounded at the healing factor and lack of prickly pain when used. Worth every penny you pay. Try them.

Overall, these are nice because I know that they're safe to use in sensitive areas. However, they tear very easily, and they're small, so I generally need to use 2-3 to get the utility out of them that I'm seeking.
Soft, good size, strong, flushable & fresh fragrance. Due to a medical condition I frequently urinate. These cloths keep me fresh all day.
These are the best wipes i’ve used. I would definitely recommend! Gonna look into purchasing more of their products

Extra soft, super fresh and moisturizing! I typically get baby wipes as they are softer but these are cheaper than other organic brands and the packaging is cute! I can leave them sitting out since they arent an eye sore like most wipe packages. I highly recommend.

I really enjoyed these. However I did have to knock a star due to the flap coming off a little easily (glue) and it’s hard to only get one wipe out at a time at first. I will say I prefer these over store brand.
I really like them ordering again it has a really clean feeling I choose wipes over toilet paper any day smells really good

Took these camping and should have brought more. Everybody liked these better than their standard wet wipes. Scent is great, they feel refreshing, and easy to seal back up. Doesn't take up a whole ton of space in your pack either. I will get some for general use in the future. Definitely recommended!

Not usually leaving reviews but these wipes blow me away. I feel so "fresh" after using the and the scent is simply amazing. 30 in a packets is also a bonus, compared to many other brands that only have 10 in a packet. Super-easy to remove 1 wipe at a time. Just the best.

These smell really good and leave me feeling fresh. The only downside is that they are hard to pull out of their packet which sometimes causes me to pull out multiple at a time and having to stuff the remainder back inside.
I used a popular brand of wipes that left me with an awful itch! I’m so glad to find these beautiful wipes-all my symptoms have disappeared
Natural smell not synthetic. I swipe down my pits with them on extra hot days and I remain smell free.
Clean and smooth Do not dry your skin!! Will buy these products agaim

reviews.t: Best value award in my book!
reviews.x: I'm a fan of wipes, and these definitely rank high—in fact, in terms of value, I'd put them at the top. They actually get you clean (unlike some brands), and strong cotton, and have a great natural, subtle citrusy scent that is way better than the more artificial perfumey smells widely available. They're so thick they're not easy to tear (I usually don't need a whole one), but can also be cut in halves if that suits your needs better.  Speaking of the price point, they're the best value you can

These are not wipes but are  sanitary pads.  They are incorrectly bundled with a sticker added labeling them as wipes.  Therefore the person pulling  the order  (scanning the item) cannot realize the mistake.  The sticker reads: X001W4K27F L. Organic Cotton Feminine Wipes  etc. I will not return these but will donate them.  However, I do feel the warehouse may want to check the stock on this item.  Thank you.

They have a very nice subtle scent and I like that they don't have any harmful ingredients but they're difficult to get out of the package. You can't just grab one wipe! No matter how I try to hold the others in I end up with three in my hand and have to try to shove them back in but they never lay flat again so more air is in the package causing them to dry out. Probably won't purchase again because of this.

This is one of my favorite brands. The wipes pull out easy and the package does not leak after it’s closed.  The scent is perfect and I never had any break outs nor an allergic reaction. I’m waiting for the company to make individual packets like the other companies: Rael, etc. so that I can fit them in my fanny pack and clutch. Finally, please sell in al stores.

We used to not have a choice when it came to feminine products. Our bodies have paid the price for ingredients that are not appropriate for daily use: chlorinated cotton, etc.  Now that I've switched to organic cotton feminine products, all of the minor woes I used to have "done there" are over. Imagine that? Buy the good stuff Ladies. You'll never look back.

I like that there isn't any ingredients that aren't really identified or that you can't pronounce. The scentn is pleasant but neutral. I have fairly sensitive skin, and these are really great at gently cleansing the areas that need it.  I keep a packet in the bathroom, and a packet in my purse.  Also, I love that they support girls & women less fortunate.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wipes for leaving them feeling fresh and clean.
Many reviewers love the scent, describing it as great or amazing.
Several reviewers complain that the wipes are hard to dispense one at a time, often coming out in clumps or requiring reaching into the pouch.
Some reviewers find the wipes small and prone to tearing, needing multiple per use.
A few reviewers mention packaging issues such as the flap coming off or being difficult to reseal.
